children: Al Rajhi Bank has mandated a group of regional and international banks to arrange a USD Tier 2 social sukuk under its international trust certificate issuance programme.
Al Rajhi Capital, Arqaam Capital, BBVA, Citi, Intesa Sanpaolo, Morgan Stanley, SMBC, Standard Chartered and Warba Bank are acting as joint lead managers and bookrunners.
The Regulation S issuance, offered to eligible investors in Saudi Arabia and internationally. It will have a 10.5-year maturity and will be callable after 5.25 years.
The securities will be listed on the London Stock Exchange's International Securities Market.
The Islamic bank last issued a $1 billion AT2 capital social sukuk in January 2026.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Rajhi Bank mandates USD Tier 2 social sukuk
